verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an official remote, hosted MCP server with Sandbox (`sandbox-mcp.paddle.com/mcp`, API key) and Live (`mcp.paddle.com/mcp`, OAuth or API key) endpoints. It exposes a codemode interface (`search`/`execute`) covering the full API, plus a separate docs MCP server and official plugins bundling both for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting and operating through the server, and built-in gating of destructive operations (safety relies on least-permission keys).
